12 - 'Change Size' selector: verify font-family, size, weight, and color match Figma exactly (correct, no fix needed)
SELECTOR CORRECTION caught before publishing: "Change Size" is implemented as the disabled placeholder `<option>` of a native `<select class="product-groups">` size picker, not a standalone styled link as Figma's mockup visually suggests. An initial check read the computed style of the `<option>` element itself and found an apparent wrong-gray color mismatch (#4d4d4d) -- but native `<option>` elements are rendered by the OS/browser widget, not by regular CSS painting, so their computed style does not reliably reflect what actually renders on screen. Re-checked against the parent `<select>` element instead (the real, visibly-styled control) and found an EXACT match to Figma on every property, including color (#444444) -- the original finding was a false positive from testing the wrong nested element. Same family of lesson as this engagement's other "verify which nested element actually carries the real computed style" pitfalls.
Passed ▼
